verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Obsidian Sync offers 'Version history - View or restore previous versions of a note' and list it as a feature, confirming core version-history/restore functionality is real and shipped as part of the paid Sync add-on. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents recovering *deleted* notes, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the restore workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deleted-note recovery, independent/hands-on verification of restore reliability.
